data.body: CI fix (Gerrit 2223 patchset 2): patchset 1's Verified gate failed on the ARG-backlog ratchet test (tests/unit/rebar_reconciler/apply/test_arg_sweep_kwargs_heldout.py::test_arg_backlog_is_substantially_reduced). The new module's coordinate_create() carried an unused keyword-only 'budget_factory' param (accepted 'for parity' with the sibling coordinator), which added the 26th ARG001 unused-arg finding repo-wide, tripping the shrink-only ratchet (assert 26 <= 25). Root cause: a genuinely-unused YAGNI parameter. Fix: removed 'budget_factory' entirely (a create is one-shot; no retry budget is threaded at the create coordinator), updated the two docstrings and the AC6 kw-only-seam assertion. Local: ARG ratchet green, 12/12 coordinator tests green, make lint + typecheck green. Re-pushed; both gates re-running.
